name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky - Enhanced Edition
description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky - Enhanced Edition is an open-world first-person shooter and survival horror game in the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. series.

eax.problem: Unlike the original Clear Sky, it comes with OpenAL Soft, which has EAX built in, so its reverb doesn't depend on a Creative sound card.
